steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Oh? That noise...

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: I presumed they would have exercised more caution... Who would have thought they had such confidence?

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Heheh. No matter. The outcome will be the same.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: The church has need of men.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Become one of us.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Then we shall bring revelation to all Iberians.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: That should be the trap set.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Just need to wait for them to get enough ingredients and get out of there. Should be enough to buy them some time.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Man, Laios, sometimes you really do think of everything.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What's a treasure chest doing here?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Let me guess, this world has mimics too?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: This one's barely even trying.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: It's a beach! There's nothing here but sand! Who does it think it's trying to fool?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hmm? Footsteps... I bet it's that weird guy.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: They will become our brethren. Soon, soon, they will become something greater...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Tch, it's him, alright. I knew he was sending us to our deaths.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I've got an idea.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: When the Inquisition comes, they too may have a taste.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: A taste of what?

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Why... Why haven't you gone inside?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I'm not much of a fighter myself, so I'm waiting outside.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: ...Is that so?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You mentioned the Inquisition. Who're they?

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Our common enemy.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Oh, mind telling me more?

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: (It seems this Durin has no talent for combat. I suppose there's no harm in chatting with him.)

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: (With his build, where could he even run off to?)

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: I do not mind.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: We might be seen talking here. How about we go chat by that chest?

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Let us begin with how the Inquisition have been fooling the people of Iberia—eh?
(Slams open) (Devours whole) (Clamps shut) (Sways contently)

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You might call them your brethren, but you don't know the first thing about these monsters.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: When you're in a party like ours, that'll cost you dearly.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: *phew* That's all of them handled!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I thought there'd be a lot more.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If they were living alongside the kraken, most probably fled when it died.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: The ones who killed it in the first place must have exquisite taste...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Think these monsters are edible, Senshi?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Well, I'm certainly not eating any! They're disgusting!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I think as long as we handle them carefully, we can turn them into healthy, delicious meals!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We're not that far from the city though, or particularly hidden. There's no reason the locals wouldn't know of this place.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: If they won't eat any of this stuff, surely that means none of it's edible?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: That mysterious priest must have sent us here to die!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Not necessarily.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: These are monsters, after all. We didn't see any weapons in town, so maybe they can't hunt here, not that they won't.

spans.text: These are monsters, after all. We didn't see any weapons in town, so maybe they
hunt here, not that they won't.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Seafood's a good source of protein. If we can make a proper meal out of them, I'm sure it'll be filling.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: NonononoNO!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: There's nothing wrong with it, the way I see it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I might not have cooked a kraken before, but I know how to handle fish, shellfish, prawns, and octopus.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Just a reminder that we don't have anything else to eat anyway. Other than whatever washes up on the beach.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I know, okay?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: This one's got a transparent head full of... some sort of sticky liquid? It surrounds the organs and this yellow thing...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Definitely can't eat the organs. Let's have a look at that yellow stuff and the liquid...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Really reminds me of an egg.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I'll try beating it in a bowl later.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Looks like the inside of an egg to me too.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You two do realize we're in the middle of taking care of the monsters, right? Can you save the cooking talk for later?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Don't say that! This is the best way to research monsters in general.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Have you noticed how you've already helped us cook these sea anemone monsters, Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh, you're right.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I think it's a bit burnt after getting hit by explosion magic.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Then there's this strange seagrass. It just withered up in the fire.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's probably inedible, right? How about we hold off on trying it?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I think you kept the heat just right.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Doesn't seem like there's any more coming out from deeper in. Guessing they're afraid of us.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I think we've gathered enough monster parts for a feast. Let's go.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Huh. Chilchuck, why's there a treasure chest next to you?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And that man out cold over there... Is that the priest?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Yep. Thought he could talk us into walking to our deaths, so I decided I'd use this chest to teach him a lesson.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wait, he was lying to us? We really did manage to get lots of seafood there, though.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And did you just say 'this guy'?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Yeah. *sigh* I figured this world was going to have mimics, too.
(Slams open) (Slapped by Chilchuck) (Unable to reach anything) (Shakes angrily)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Seems you've got it under control.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Well, it's pretty crappy at hiding itself.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Anyway, I assume you're going to want to see what this world's mimics taste like, so here, take it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wow, really?! You're the best!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Whispers) Does this count as playing nice with him?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: (Whispers) Probably.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: (Whispers) You're a good egg, lad.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: (Whispers) Shut up!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: C'mon, let's go start a fire on the beach!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Let's start by opening up this one that looks like a sea anemone.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I was thinking earlier... It should be here... Yep, there it is! Its head is on the bottom.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eh? That flower organ on the top isn't its head?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Let's cut it open and get a better look. The head's structured a lot like a starfish...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Peel back its skin a bit...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Oho, it really is all yellow inside! Every 'petal' seems to be the same. I think this is its reproductive organ.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Now I really don't feel like eating it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I know, I know, I'm not gonna eat another sea creature raw.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Like I said, you need to handle that stuff carefully or you're definitely getting a stomachache!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But properly-made normal ceviche and sashimi are delicious. Remember that for next time!

spans.text: ceviche and sashimi are delicious. Remember that for next time!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Then, how do you properly prepare 'normal' raw food?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hah! Told you not to say anything!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well? Go on.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Add mustard, lemon slices, onion, coriander, and minced garlic to soy sauce. If you have fish sauce, add a dash if you'd like, then in goes the raw seafood. Mix well and leave to marinate.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Something along those lines.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Sounds great!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: ...But we don't have any soy sauce or mustard.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: We do have this. I noticed half a box of... 'Emergency Sanity Potions' tucked away in a corner of the cave.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Says here: 'Contains mustard extract.' Might be some sort of seasoning.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...'Manufactured by Rhodes Island'?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: A product of the place we're looking for. If this is here, we might be closer than we thought.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Might as well use it to give the meat some flavor.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Just need to cut these up into the right size, put them in a container, add in some 'Emergency Sanity Potion,' onion and minced garlic, then finally add the raw meat and mix it all together...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Here, try some.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Delicious!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: As for everything else...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: A big pile of roast seagrass.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: About a dozen of those egg monsters.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Another dozen of the sea anemone ones.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: And one mimic.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Yep, this should be plenty.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: And there you have it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It looks like a lot, but there's still plenty left over. Should be enough to feed the city folk.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It all smells amazing.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmm... Even though it's a monster meat feast, it actually looks pretty good once it's all cooked.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Do you really plan to share all this with the people in town? Seems to me like you guys are itching to dig in.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But they don't even understand us when we speak...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I've got a plan.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We start eating here, by the coast, which will attract those wandering the beach.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It's clear they still possess some sort of reason. We let them eat their fill, then they can share the rest with their friends.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: So, just an excuse after all.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hmm... The locals might not be too familiar with this style of cooking. I do think we should demonstrate that it's edible first.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You heard him. Eat up, everyone.
I want more seaweed alcohol!

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Oh, you're such a glutton.
Because it's delicious!

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Well, I'm glad you like it.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: I hope the singer will like it too, the next time she stops by.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Male Resident
steps.text: The outsiders are at the beach.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Huh? The beach?

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: What are they doing there?

steps.name: Male Resident
steps.text: Cooking.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Cooking?

steps.name: Male Resident
steps.text: With monsters from the sea.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: What?! I need to go stop them, quick!

steps.name: Male Resident
steps.text: Too late.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: This ceviche is really sharp.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Texture's good though. Haven't had anything like it before.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: This world's mimics turned out to be pretty tasty too.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Kin... We many... What's that smell? It's good...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Oh. That lying priest's woken up.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: So very good... Wait, what are you doing?! You... What the hell is that you're cooking?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, hey there, Mister Priest. That cave you told us about really was full of seafood!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: The townspeople don't need to go hungry any longer!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Want to try some?

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: You... You... This is blasphemy! Blasphemy of the highest order!

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: M-My brethren, I will not allow—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh dear. Looks like he's passed out again.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Maybe he's hungry?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I've got it! We can gather up some of that strange seagrass and use the tingle to wake him up!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I already told you, he tried to get us killed! Why do you care about him so much?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No matter how you cut it, Chilchuck, we're only having this feast thanks to him.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We ought to show our gratitude somehow.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I really don't get you.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Alright, come help me gather some seagrass while the bonfire's still lit!

steps.name: Chilchuck & Marcille
steps.text: Hey, you're just doing this because you're still hungry!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Augh, the water's so cold...
Anita finally reaches the shore, but it seems she is too late.
Upon a beach fallen into silence, people have gathered for the first time in a long while.
A group of four have rolled up their trousers and waded into the sea in high spirits, breaking out into laughter on occasion.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wow! There's creatures here nibbling at my toes!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh? Th-Then doesn't that mean the stuff we just ate was...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: That's just how things are in most places, Marcille.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I think I hear people yelling behind us.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh wow, there's some glowing round thing over there! I'm gonna go have a look!

steps.name: Male Resident
steps.text: Ahh! Ahhhhh!!

steps.name: Male Resident
steps.text: They—! Th-th-th-they—!

steps.name: Male Resident
steps.text: AHHHHHHHH!
All Anita can think of while looking at the scene before her is that...
It seems the sea breeze blowing towards Sal Viento today is stinging her eyes. All this is... something she never imagined she'd see her entire life.
